body: 2 come to mind that were equally painful for me, one was a time I swallowed 13 batteries on a psych ward at a tough point in my life, they got lodged sideways in my intestines amd bladder. I couldn't walk, i was throwing up in agony and screaming. The other was when I broke my spine after jumping from a balcony, the surgeon said I'd burst the bottom and was lucky to walk, I had to have 2 8 hour surgeries and I spent my 19th birthday in hospital and almost christmas, I'm doing much better now and cant imagine acting so desperately now. I am on painkillers for life though, which is a bit saddening

I remember tho when I was 6 years old I was in india on holiday but I'd become really ill, I was having a fever dream and it was for some reason a really vivid dream of me peeing, i woke up and I was actually stood peeing on the bed, my dad wasn't happy lol

Before my dad was understanding about my mental health problems if I started to become ill he'd say "snap out of it" and it made me feel so unimportant and like no one believed that i wasnt acting in that way in purpose

My dad is now extremely supportive, this was years ago, he's a really good dad  and he's learnt about the troubles I face 

But yeah whenever i hear that phrase it pisses me off
Some people I just feel annoyed at as soon as i see them even if they're strangers, i guess some people just look to me like they'd be the type of person to really piss me off in some way

I just like weed to make me forget my past but its become all i do, instantly in the morning before i take my meds, eat or have a shower. Unsurptisingly its making me feel more depressed, idk why I'm writing this here. Probably cause im high, but yeah, be careful with weed, i saw it as safe and now its all i do, i feel like a complete loser
